items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Shufar Redman and Redman' in a question, but the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection, only continuing to discuss their own career path ('Minneapolis at Tuchman's Grumor Cafe').

ctx.x: Shufar Redman and Redman. You were from a family of musicians and entertainers. That's right. Grandfather and grandmother. So what happens after Milwaukee?
Uh, Minneapolis at Tuchman's Grumor Cafe. German restaurant.
